verdict.rationale: Name.com has a first-party guide on domain renewals and post-expiration recovery that covers auto-renew, manual renew, a Guaranteed Renewal Window and webhooks, and autorenew is listed as a per-domain setting. Webhook subscriptions cover renewal events, but nothing in the pack documents proactive expiry reminders or the actual lengths of the grace and redemption periods. Missing for 10: explicit expiry-notice/reminder emails before lapse, documented grace and redemption window durations and fees, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, renewals never surprise me — auto-renew controls per domain, expiry notices, and documented grace/redemption windows if something lapses
